instruction: Adjust the cell sizes in the spreadsheet to fit it onto a single page and save it as a PDF.

metadata.explanation: Task requires compressing spreadsheet by resizing cells to fit on one PDF page. Evaluator validates PDF is well-formed and contains exactly 1 page. Similar to original with emphasis on cell resizing.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both instruction requirements: (1) PDF export completed, (2) spreadsheet compressed to fit on one page
Getter logic correctly extracts PDF metadata (page count and validity) from the expected output file path
Metric logic correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('page_count') matching the rules dictionary structure
Metric correctly validates PDF is well-formed (valid=True) and has exactly 1 page
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns {page_count, valid} -> metric compares result vs expected rules
No postconfig needed - PDF file persists after export, state is stable
Verification approach is appropriate: checks outcome (single-page PDF) rather than process (how cells were resized), which correctly validates task completion
